description:
This is a Sources Sought Notice/Request for Information (RFI) for project CL25351002 to be used for market research purposes. DLA Weapons Support (Columbus) is seeking information regarding companies’ capabilities to provide 2540-01-377-4293 on an Indefinite Delivery Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ) basis. This notice is issued solely for informational and planning purposes. It does not constitute a Request for Proposal (RFP) or in any way provide implication or obligation that a solicitation/RFP will be released in the future. This request for information does not commit the Government to contract for any supply or service for these requirements.

Thank you in advance for your assistance.
